_about: Every rectangle and every rule a table design may draw into or rely on, taken from src/ and never from a mockup or a screenshot. x/y/w/h are virtual canvas px on the 1280x720 canvas. 'src' is the line the number was read from. Anything under 'frozen' may not move.

card_sizes._note: shared by every mode including the frozen Action Card mode: treat as fixed

field_slots._note: sticky slots; claim order in k_table_slot_order[] src/ui_board.c:553-558; dealt by month then centred, src/ui_board.c:575-603

panel_border._note: already frames every panel in the game at its exact rect, inside it. The cheapest place for a metal look.

card_face._note: 1 px edge line today; all modes

action_card_stock.why: hash-guarded file; must keep the same anchor

action_card_meter.why: hash-guarded file; sits 16 px left of FIELD_X

guard_manifest.why: 12 lines outside ui_action.* must stay verbatim; 4 of them inside board_draw_table()

left_column_between_halves._note: CPU lanes end 207.6, player lanes start 508 -> 300 px tall, full left column width. This is the only place a spine/connector band fits.

capture_lane.verdict: a frame INSIDE a lane eats the label; a frame AROUND a lane collides with the next lane. Per-lane frames are impossible; frame the group.

combo_panel.verdict: 8 px is the maximum border inside; the panel has 80 px of free space on its LEFT

right_column_free_space.verdict: a uniform border is forced down to 8 px by the right edge. Use an ASYMMETRIC border (thick inside, thin at the canvas edge).

left_column_seam.verdict: 8 px rails at y 40 and y 670 separate the score strip from the lanes; rails must be drawn AFTER the block frame or the casing covers them

field_painting_the_truth._why: Two different field layouts exist in the repo and only one is live. Three wasted rounds came from compositing onto a figure drawn with the dead one.

live.grid: 8 cols x 2 rows, primary slots 0..15, overflow 16..23

dead.status: no callers. Only reachable via board_get_field_card_rect() (src/ui_board.c:531), which also has no callers.
dead.numbers: step 96, two rows y 170 / 310, centred in 430..1080

dead_in_repo_figure.problem: it draws the README's 1:1 table figure with board_field_slot_xy(), so docs/assets/readme/table-map.png shows field cards 96 px apart on a grid where the game actually puts them 81 px apart. Anything composited onto that figure looks misaligned even when it is not.
dead_in_repo_figure.knock_on: the README section 'The table, to scale' and its legend inherit the same error

dealing.sort: board_field_sort_slots() sorts the opening field by month (src/board_layout.c:5-14, still used at src/ui_board.c:590)
dealing.centre: c0 = (8 - top)/2, c1 = (8 - bottom)/2 -> 8 cards land in columns 2..5, 14 cards in 0..6, 16 cards full
dealing.sticky: after the deal a card keeps its slot; a capture frees it in place; an unmatched card claims an empty slot
dealing.card_ids: id = (month-1)*4 + slot, 0..47 (src/cards.h:20). Month 1 = ids 0..3. A dealer-select demo that deals ids {0,4,8,12,16,20,24,28} shows four DIFFERENT cards, not four January ones.

card_rects._note: atlas cell is 176 x 286 (assets/atlas.png is 2112 x 1144 = 12 x 4 cells), so any card rect is a downscale of the same cell and a bezel can be drawn per size

composite_rules._why: how to build a preview that cannot lie to you
composite_rules.base: draw the base yourself at 1280x720: back.png at 56x91 step 62 for the CPU hand, table_slot_rect() slots with atlas cells for the field, 88x143 step 96 for the hand
composite_rules.check: one preview on the real backdrop (assets/<name>.jpg) and one on a flat dark canvas; if a frame looks right on one and wrong on the other, the base is suspect, not the frame

backdrops.note: nine tables = these eight plus the Deus backdrop

assets_available.absent: no frame, border, bezel or panel texture ships. A metal look is either drawn procedurally in ui_draw_panel_border() or generated as a 9-slice asset.

fills._why: What the game actually paints at rest, which is not the same as the rect list. A composite that skips these looks wrong even when every frame is placed correctly.

info_box._note: the only 255x30 strips; when idle they also get ui_draw_panel_border INSIDE the rect

field._note: board_get_field_rect() is a bbox only - nothing is painted there. Cards sit straight on the backdrop, so any field panel is new art and will change the look

lane_mini.label: "B 0".."P 0" at 16, y+8.5, font 20, spacing 1.4, src/ui_board.c:771
lane_mini.verdict: a mini is 17 x 31 with a 20 px label beside it - far too small for a bezel

atlas_variants.deus: assets/atlas_deus.png, same grid, used when settings.difficulty == DIFFICULTY_DEUS, src/ui_board.c:723
atlas_variants.back: assets/back.png 1024x1536 stretched to any card rect, src/ui_board.c:729-731
